## Zoning Evaluation: 6247 N Rockwell St (PIN 13012120030000)

---

### 1. Zoning District

This parcel is zoned **RS-2** (Residential Single-Unit – Detached House), per the City of Chicago's official GIS zoning system. You can verify this on the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).

---

### 2. Can I Build a Two-Flat Here?

**Generally no — not by right in RS-2.** [5] explains that RS districts are intended primarily for detached houses on individual lots. Two-flats are the primary purpose of RT districts, not RS.

There is one narrow exception under [1]: in an **RS3** district (not RS2), the minimum lot area per unit may be reduced to 1,500 sq ft to allow a two-unit building when 60% or more of the block face is already improved with multi-unit buildings ("Predominance of the Block" rule). This RS3 exception **does not apply to RS-2**.

**Conclusion:** A two-flat would require a **rezoning** of the parcel, at minimum to RS-3 or RT-3.5/RT-4. Verify with the Chicago Zoning Department or a zoning attorney.

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards (RS-2)

The retrieved code text covers density and parking rules but does not include the full RS-2 bulk table (FAR, height, setbacks). Here is what is confirmed:

- **Minimum lot area per unit:** Governed by [1] (§17-2-0303-A); the specific RS-2 table value was not in the retrieved text — verify via the Zoning Ordinance bulk table for RS-2 or the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).
- **Lot area per unit exemptions:** Ground-floor Type A accessible units in RS3/RT districts are exempt from density calculations [1], but this applies to RS3, RT3.5, and RT4 — **not RS-2**.
- **FAR, maximum height, and setbacks:** Not present in the retrieved Municipal Code text. You must verify these directly in the Zoning Ordinance bulk table for RS-2 (Title 17, Chapter 17-2, Table 17-2-0303 and §17-2-0400/0500).

---

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit Reduction

Off-street parking for residential uses must be located on the same zoning lot as the dwelling units served [2]. In RS districts, parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line, except when accessed by a permitted driveway from the front [2].

**Transit reduction:** This parcel is **not** in a TOD area and `tod_benefits` are not applicable. No transit-based parking reduction is available here.

The specific number of required spaces for an RS-2 single-family home was not in the retrieved code text — verify in §17-10-0200 of the Zoning Ordinance.

---

### 6. Coach House / ADU

**No — not currently permitted here by right.** Under [3] and [4], a coach house may only be built on an RS-designated lot if it is within a designated **Additional Dwelling Unit-Allowed RS Area** (§17-7-0570). This parcel is **not** in such an area.

If it were eligible, key coach house rules would include [3]:
- Max building height: **22 feet**
- Must be in the rear of the lot; rooftop features also capped at 22 feet
- At least 3 feet of open, unobstructed side yard required for the full length of the building wall
- The principal building must be **owner-occupied** at time of pre-certification [4]
- Annual limits apply per block face [4]
- An **administrative adjustment** (§17-13-1003-QQ) would be required [4]

**Conclusion:** No coach house is permitted on this lot unless the City expands the ADU-allowed area to include this block face.

---

### Confidence & Limitations

**High confidence:** Zoning classification (RS-2), overlay status, flood zone, ADU area status, ARO applicability, TOD ineligibility, and coach house rules.

**Could not determine from retrieved text:** Specific RS-2 FAR, maximum height, front/rear/side setback dimensions, and the exact number of required parking spaces. These require consulting the full §17-2-0300 bulk table and §17-10-0200 in the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.
